title: cystopteris fragilis var. dickieana
intro: Cystopteris fragilis var. dickieana, commonly known as Dickie's fragile fern, is a rare and endangered fern species native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dickie's fragile fern include reducing inflammation, combating infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
